repoImprovements.title: Add rendered-content assertions to E2E test
repoImprovements.detail: The current E2E test verifies data.json structure and file presence but does not assert what the browser renders. A Playwright-based test that navigates to the rendered HTML and checks that key elements are populated (e.g., verdict banner has a class, stats row has non-empty values) would have caught the 10 schema field mismatches before code review.

repoImprovements.title: Generate a reference analysis.json fixture from a real session
repoImprovements.detail: The test fixture in test-e2e.sh is hand-crafted. A generated fixture from a real short session would keep the fixture aligned with what the generate skill actually produces, preventing field name drift between schema definition and renderer.

repoImprovements.title: Add schema validation step to render-html.sh
repoImprovements.detail: render-html.sh could run jq to verify analysis.json has at least the top-level v2 fields before rendering. If the file uses the old 3-field schema, it could emit a warning so the user knows the report will show empty states.

repoImprovements.title: Document the two-server requirement in README
repoImprovements.detail: eval pack reports require fetch('data.json') which is blocked on file:// protocol. The README should prominently document that reports must be served over HTTP (python3 -m http.server) and ideally the /review skill should auto-start a server.

userImprovements.title: Run /eval-pack:generate after each session, not just at PR time
userImprovements.detail: Generating the eval pack mid-session (before context is lost) produces richer analysis because the model still has full context. End-of-session generation requires reconstructing intent from transcript alone.

userImprovements.title: Include screenshot evidence during the session
userImprovements.detail: The Playwright verification screenshots taken during this session weren't linked to the eval pack. Saving screenshots to .eval-packs/<session>/screenshots/ during the session would populate the Proof panel's artifact inventory.
